page_title: SAS 1-1 TOR | Sassuolo v Torino 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+6' Andrea Consigli pulls off a fantastic save! Duvan Zapata (Torino) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top right corner, but the effort is kept out.
90+5' Here is a change. Martin Erlic is going off and Alessio Dionisi gives the last tactical orders to Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo).
90+5' Substitution. Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) in, Josh Doig out.
90+1' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' What a great effort! Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
90' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) picks up a yellow card.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) will replace Andrea Pinamonti.
88' Uros Racic (Sassuolo) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
88' David Okereke (Torino) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
87' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
83' Ivan Juric has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Saba Sazonov (Torino) replacing Matteo Lovato.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) comes onto the pitch for Raoul Bellanova.
82' Adrien Tameze (Torino) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
81' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

81' What a wasted opportunity by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes an astonishing save to thwart him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sassuolo.
80' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
79' David Okereke (Torino) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.

78' Duvan Zapata (Torino) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
77' Torino win a corner.
77' Good clearance! Duvan Zapata (Torino) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
75' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Today's match ends for Antonio Sanabria who will be replaced by David Okereke (Torino).
73' It will be a substitution. Samuele Ricci (Torino) is ready to enter the pitch as Ivan Ilic walks off.
73' Alessio Dionisi prepares a substitution. Nedim Bajrami is replaced by Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo).
72' Here comes a substitution. Uros Racic (Sassuolo) is brought on as a substitute for Luca Lipani.
70' Torino are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
66' Yellow card. Matteo Lovato (Torino) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
65' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
64' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Orsato had a clear view and blows his whistle.
63' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
63' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Sassuolo will have a corner.
62' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

61' Ivan Ilic (Torino) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
59' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
57' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
56' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
54' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
53' The corner kick from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
53' Duvan Zapata (Torino) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Torino earn a corner.
52' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
49' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

48' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Martin Erlic (Sassuolo). Daniele Orsato saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Torino win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
47' Duvan Zapata (Torino) is repeatedly being caught offside, but this is to be expected given that he always plays on the shoulder of the last defender.
46' Ivan Ilic (Torino) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Daniele Orsato has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) towards the middle of the goal.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Nikola Vlasic (Torino). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
40' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:1.
38' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
37' Matteo Lovato (Torino) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
32' It looks like Duvan Zapata (Torino) saw red with that tackle. Daniele Orsato won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
30' Duvan Zapata (Torino) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
30' Ivan Ilic (Torino) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

29' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes behind for a corner. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
27' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
23' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
23' The corner from Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) is cleared away by the defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Sassuolo are going to take it.
23' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick.
20' Substitution. Adam Masina (Torino) on for Ricardo Rodriguez.
19' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
17' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
16' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
13' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

11' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
9' 1 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Duvan Zapata (Torino) was set free in the area by Raoul Bellanova and fired past Andrea Consigli. 1:1.
8' Flag goes up against Duvan Zapata (Torino) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

5' 1 - 0 Goal – 1:0! Marcus Pedersen sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the left side of the goal.
4' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Orsato blows for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
Torino will kick the game off.
Daniele Orsato got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
